result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.select_edges_by_id()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Select edges by their IDs. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L5615-L5665){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.select_edges_by_id(edge_ids) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Marks specified edges as selected for subsequent operations. Edge IDs are internal integer identifiers assigned when edges are created. Selection is cumulative unless cleared first. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [edge_ids]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of edge IDs to select. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [KeyError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If any edge ID doesn't exist in the graph. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Select specific edges: ::: {#1209e2fb .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="C") .add_edge(source="C", target="A") ) edge_ids = graph.get_edge_ids() graph.select_edges_by_id(edge_ids=[edge_ids[0], edge_ids[1]]) selected_count = graph.count_selected_edges() # Returns 2 selected_count ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 2 ``` ::: :::
